text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Hosni Mubarak to announce the features of the plan for Egypt's progress in the 21st century.
- Efforts are underway to strengthen Saudi cooperation with Egypt. $1.1 billion will go to setting up five tourism, industrial and joint real estate companies.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri headed a ministerial meeting and says that there are 79 industrial investment and heavy industry zones.

- Six Damascus Declaration states to meet in Cairo on Saturday and Egypt and Syria are to join efforts to mediate between Qatar and Bahrain to solve their dispute. Foreign ministers from the other Damascus Declaration states - Kuwait, Oman, United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia - arrive in Cairo on Friday to attend the meeting.
- Group of Moslem Brotherhood members is detained.

- Ministerial talks between Egypt and Saudi Arabia yielded positive results. A holding company will be set up to invest in tourism and other industries with capital of $500 million, as well as one with a $250 million capital to produce iron and glass.
